about: Licenses WeaveSharp accepts for its dependencies without a separate decision. A package under any other license needs an exception below, with its use, its reason and the decision that allows it; a license for code that ships in an extension is the operator's decision. Uses listed in unrestrictedUses ship nothing (experiments/), so their packages' licenses are recorded in the register but not restricted; code moves from experiments/ into the product only through SEC-05's license review. See docs/dependencies/README.md.
